Mugen Climb
Double Breaker
■ This creature can't be blocked.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, draw up to 2 cards.
■ Whenever this creature attacks, discard up to 2 cards from your hand. For each card you discard in this way, choose one of your opponent's creatures and put it on top of or under your opponent's deck.

■ このクリーチャーが攻撃する時、自分の手札を2枚まで捨てる。このようにして捨てた手札1枚につき、相手のクリーチャーを1体選び、相手はそれを自身の山札の上または下に置く。
